Hi team,

Following our 1:1s this week, attaching a first-pass SOW from Bridgewell Coaching for the "New Manager Bootcamp" pilot. High-level ask: run a 6-week cohort for ~24 new managers (mix of IC->mgr promotions and external hires) that includes:
- Week 1: policy onboarding + performance calibration (Redwood-specific templates)
- Week 2: 1:1 structure and career conversation frameworks
- Week 3: Difficult/confrontational conversations (role plays)
- Weeks 4–6: Manager drop-ins + coaching triage

Attachments: manager_bootcamp_sow_bridgewell.pdf, draft_calendarslots.xlsx

Key decisions we need this week: budget approval, participant roster, whether to include a separate 1:1 calibration session for mid-year reviewers (sensitive). Also flagging that PeopleOps legal will need to review the coach agreements.

Can everyone reply with: (1) roster yes/no, (2) any mandatory curricular changes, (3) budget thumbs-up?

Thanks — Priya
